name: Rome
attacked: Ambitious. You seek to conquer me before I move on you. I approve.
denounced: You had better mean what you say. I, for one, do not make idle threats..!
introduction: I am Caesar, destroyer of conspiracies in the Alpine woods and the Senate alike.
tradeRequest: I offer this, for your consideration.

name: China
declaringWar: How dare you enrage Tian's might! I will send a great army, desecrate your ancestral shrines, eliminate your people. I swear I won't restrain them!
attacked: Fight if you want to. Soon I will punish and kill you!
defeated: I never would have thought... not like this.
denounced: So, an insect dares to offend a dragon. That was not wise.
introduction: You've come today. Is it possible that you want to view the scenery of the mountains and rivers in the State of Qin? I am the ruler of Qin.
